description: The review sets out a research agenda: future studies should assess AEEs with practising health professionals rather than students, use larger sample sizes, report adaptivity methods, goals, timing, factors and types...
title: Future research agenda for adaptive e-learning in health professions education

description: The article recommends overcoming the dichotomy between decorative and instructional pictures by using aesthetic pictures inside picture-related tasks, so they serve an instructional purpose beyond decoration.
title: Integrate aesthetic pictures into physics tasks at the start of a lesson and for application and transfer
